description: This file defines an abstract class ResolveInsertionBase used in Spark SQL's catalyst analysis module. It provides functionality to create a projection for INSERT INTO BY NAME statements, including resolving column names, handling data type casting, and renaming struct fields to match expected schemas.

classes.name: ResolveInsertionBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to assist in resolving insert statements by name, including schema validation and field renaming.

methods.name: createProjectForByNameQuery
methods.description: Creates a projection plan for INSERT INTO BY NAME, resolving column names, checking schema consistency, and casting/renaming fields as necessary.

methods.name: renameFieldsInStruct
methods.description: Recursively renames fields within nested StructType schemas to match expected schema field names.
